headline: One injured as crude bombs explode in four Dhaka areas
summary: Explosions were reported in Malibagh, Mohakhali, and Jatrabari, leaving an auto-rickshaw driver wounded.
details: Several crude bombs exploded in different parts of the capital city, Dhaka, causing panic among residents.
Incidents were reported in four areas, including Malibagh, Mohakhali, and Jatrabari, according to multiple news reports.
In Jatrabari, a crude bomb exploded near the police station, resulting in the injury of an auto-rickshaw driver.
Two crude bombs were specifically reported to have exploded near the Malibagh Railgate area.
Security forces have been alerted as authorities investigate the cause and perpetrators behind the coordinated blasts.
caption:
Chaos in the capital: crude bombs explode across four different areas of Dhaka.

Several crude bombs exploded in different parts of the capital city, Dhaka, causing panic among residents.

Incidents were reported in four areas, including Malibagh, Mohakhali, and Jatrabari, according to multiple news reports.

In Jatrabari, a crude bomb exploded near the police station, resulting in the injury of an auto-rickshaw driver.

Two crude bombs were specifically reported to have exploded near the Malibagh Railgate area.

Security forces have been alerted as authorities investigate the cause and perpetrators behind the coordinated blasts.

headline: Mob vandalises rape suspect's house in Pabna
summary: An enraged crowd destroyed the home of a man suspected of raping and killing a 10-year-old girl in Kulunia village.
details: A mob vandalised the house of a rape suspect in the Kulunia village of Pabna Sadar upazila today, despite the presence of law enforcement officers.
The attack followed the recovery of the decomposed body of a 10-year-old girl from a pond near her home on Wednesday morning, seven days after she went missing.
Police identified and arrested two suspects: 55-year-old Md Mostafa Kamal, a local grocery shopkeeper, and Md Easin, a tenant.
According to the police, the suspects allegedly raped and strangled the girl on September 9, hid her body in a bag under a bed, and later dumped it in a pond.

Enraged locals, upon hearing the news, targeted Mostafa's home. Police stated that while they could not prevent the structural destruction of the house, they managed to protect the family members and secure valuables.
The Pabna Sadar Police Station OC noted that the small police force was unable to stop the large, agitated crowd.
caption:
A 10-year-old girl was raped and killed; now a mob has destroyed the suspect's home in Pabna.

A mob vandalised the house of a rape suspect in the Kulunia village of Pabna Sadar upazila today, despite the presence of law enforcement officers.

The attack followed the recovery of the decomposed body of a 10-year-old girl from a pond near her home on Wednesday morning, seven days after she went missing.

Police identified and arrested two suspects: 55-year-old Md Mostafa Kamal, a local grocery shopkeeper, and Md Easin, a tenant.

According to the police, the suspects allegedly raped and strangled the girl on September 9, hid her body in a bag under a bed, and later dumped it in a pond.

Enraged locals, upon hearing the news, targeted Mostafa's home. Police stated that while they could not prevent the structural destruction of the house, they managed to protect the family members and secure valuables.

The Pabna Sadar Police Station OC noted that the small police force was unable to stop the large, agitated crowd.
